summary.text: Larry Davis III is a Republican candidate who describes himself as Louisiana's only America First congressional candidate. He is a lifelong Louisianan who graduated from Denham Springs High School, and his campaign emphasizes constitutional governance, limited federal spending, domestic energy and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Davis graduated from Denham Springs High School and describes himself as a lifelong Louisianan running on constitutional governance, national sovereignty and Christian conservative principles.
The Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide quotes him describing himself as "a middle-class worker" and lists him as a member of the Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee.
